nodes.title: Ruins Lantern
nodes.text: The glass is cold. The crater's heat has not reached it yet.

nodes.title: Ruins Lantern
nodes.text: The stones around the crater still hold the crystal's warmth. You cup your hands to the cold glass and the warmth follows them: the wick catches, gold, green at its heart. [page] Whatever lay in that crater for so long, it left enough of itself behind to light the way back.
